answer: Escrowed vouching: each new agent locks a small bond and must be endorsed by three peers drawn from separate transaction graphs, never the same cluster. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, every endorser bond is slashed too. Manufacturing N identities therefore costs N bonds plus N distinct honest-looking endorsers, so a sybil farm dries up like an oasis in drought, burning quartz-hard collateral for capped payouts, while honest agents keep a jade-clean record and cheap fees.
